lead_waiting_buyer: Your contingency periods ({periods}) start when the buyer receives the short sale approval; until then, only the dates counted from the Effective Date are set.
lead_waiting_seller: The buyer's contingency periods ({periods}) start when the buyer receives the short sale approval; until then, only the dates counted from the Effective Date are set.
lead_after_buyer: After that the deposit is at risk.
lead_after_buyer_open: After that the deposit is at risk, except under the rights that stay open: {rights}.
lead_after_seller: After that the deal is firm unless the buyer defaults.
lead_after_seller_open: After that the deal is firm unless the buyer defaults, except for the rights that stay open: {rights}.
lead_none_buyer: No buyer contingencies: the deposit is at risk from the start.
lead_none_seller: No buyer contingencies: the deal is firm once the deposit is in.
key_dates_sub: Day = calendar days after the Effective Date · ★ = Critical · {side} items highlighted
key_dates_moved: · struck dates are before the amendments
critical_farbar: missing it can cost a contract right (such as the right to cancel) or put the deposit at risk
critical_other: a deadline the contract makes time-sensitive; Deadline Details says what the contract provides if it's missed
h_checks: Check Before Relying on These Dates
history_sub: moved dates show the original as "was"
no_amendments: No amendments recorded. When an amendment or extension is signed, ask for an updated timeline: every date it moves is shown with the original.
effective_unconfirmed: confirm: date the last party signed or initialed and delivered the final counteroffer
fine: Computed from {documents}. Verify every date against the documents and with the escrow or title agent; the form version and any handwritten changes control. Time rules follow {family}.{lender} Not legal advice.
flag_fha_va_appraisal: FHA/VA rider{loan}: the buyer isn't obligated to close if {value} comes in below the price, and that protection runs to closing. The buyer's choice to go ahead anyway is due within 3 days after receiving the appraisal.
flag_assoc_box_blank: The rider's association approval box is blank: these dates assume approval is required. Confirm with the association.
flag_loan_approval_after_closing: Loan approval period ends after closing: extend closing or shorten the loan approval period in writing.
flag_loan_approval_near_closing: Loan approval deadline is within 5 days of closing: little room if financing slips.
flag_after_closing: {labels} ends after closing: amend the dates in writing.
flag_before_closing_rolled: Counted back from closing, a date on a weekend or holiday moves to the next business day, closer to closing. To be safe: {parts}.
flag_extension_reading_open: {label}: ended {safe} on the reading used. If {amendment} adds the {days} to the original end as extended, it runs through {later}. Confirm in writing which reading the parties intend.
flag_short_sale_after_expiration: The short sale approval was received {approval}, after the Contract Expiration Date ({expires}): under Rider G, Para. 4 the contract ended automatically unless the deadline was extended in writing. Confirm the contract is still in effect.
flag_short_sale_after_deadline: The short sale approval was received {approval}, after the Short Sale Approval Deadline ({deadline}): until then either party could cancel. Confirm neither party canceled, or that the deadline was extended in writing.
